title: Póster de Receta de Té de Bienestar para el Solsticio de Invierno: Exhibición en Caja de Sombras con Instrucciones de Preparación Paso a Paso
prompt: Create a straight-on photograph showing two vertically arranged elements centered against a pure white wall background. The upper element is a handcrafted light oak wooden shadow box frame mounted on the wall. Inside, against textured off-white rice paper backing with hand-torn deckled edges, delicate dried silver fern fronds and native New Zealand flax flowers are scattered as winter seasonal decoration. At top center is large black traditional calligraphy reading 'Winter Solstice' in bold forceful brush strokes, flanked by small cinnabar red traditional seals. Below in smaller elegant script is a wellness wisdom quote about winter nourishment. In the center-left arrangement are two adorable handmade clay figurines, each 2 inches tall: the first child wears a cream wool sweater and holds a small kumara sweet potato with a cheerful expression and rosy cheeks; the second child wears a sage green cardigan and is reaching toward a honey jar with curious wide eyes and a knitted scarf. Both are hand-painted in winter earth tones, positioned as if sharing their harvest treasures. In the center-right arrangement is an artful curation of dried ingredients including two small corked glass vials at different heights, one with dried manuka honey crystals and one with kawakawa leaves, pinned with antique brass pins. Additional elements include dried ginger slices, lemon myrtle, horopito pepper leaves, and dried feijoa pieces lifted to create shadows. A miniature jade-green glazed teapot sits at 1-inch scale. Hand-written aged paper labels read 'Manuka Honey', 'Kawakawa', 'Ginger', 'Lemon Myrtle', 'Horopito', and 'Feijoa'. On the left side is a vertical label reading 'Winter Wellness Tea'. The lower element is a large rectangular premium textured rice paper measuring 12 x 16 inches, mounted below with hand-torn edges and visible paper fibers. A burlap sample pouch with a wooden bead tied with hemp string is pinned to the top right corner. At the top section, 'Preparation Instructions' appears in large elegant black traditional font, bold and prominent, with a thin double-line decorative border beneath and small fern illustrations flanking the title. The main content shows 4 illustrated steps in horizontal layout. The illustration style is clean line art, whimsical but instructional, resembling traditional craft instruction mixed with modern cookbook illustration with subtle color washes. The lighting is soft winter afternoon light from upper left with gentle shadows. The composition uses an 85mm lens at f/5.6, perfectly centered vertical alignment in 3:4 portrait orientation with an ultra-clean white wall and museum-quality gallery presentation. The winter solstice color palette includes deep forest green, warm amber, cream white, silver grey, and soft lavender tones.
